en-GB.name: Swoop: Tuck & Soar
en-GB.subtitle: Fold your phone. Fly.
en-GB.description:
The two halves of your iPhone Duo are a bird's wings.

Hold your Duo open like a book, one hand on each half. Fold it a little and your bird folds its wings and dives down the face of an ocean wave, picking up speed. Open it at the bottom and the bird flies off the top. One fold per wave: you never flap. A storm is chasing you out to sea. Stay ahead of it and reach the lighthouses along the route.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No data collected. Pay once and it's yours.

FLIGHT SCHOOL
Your first flight starts with a short lesson on a calm practice sea. A guide gull shows each move first, then you copy it: fold, open, land, and how the storm works. Skip it if you like, and replay it from Settings any time.

MADE FOR THE FOLD. PLAYS ON OTHER iPhone MODELS TOO.
On iPhone Duo, the hinge is the control: easy folds of about 30° from a relaxed book pose, roughly one per wave. You never need to close the phone, lay it flat or fold fast. iPhone Duo softens one half of the screen for a moment when a fold starts from flat, so your bird flies on the half that stays sharp, and Settings lets you pick the side. On any other iPhone, press and hold anywhere on the way down and let go on the way up. Same sea, same top scores, but the fold is the best way to fly.

ONE MOVE, A LOT OF SKILL
• Fold (or hold) on the way down: heavier is faster
• Open (or let go) on the way up: lighter flies further
• Land on the way down of the next wave for a Perfect and a little extra speed
• Three perfect landings in a row: Tailwind! A golden trail and a burst of speed
• Nose-dive into a rising wave and you'll know about it: a big, heavy splash

STAY AHEAD OF THE STORM
The storm follows you, a wall of slate cloud and slanting rain, and it gets faster the longer you fly. Ahead, across the fold, the sky stays clear and golden. Perfect landings push the storm back. Sooner or later it catches up and the flight is over: no crash, just one more go.

THE ROUTE
The lighthouses are fixed places on a route out to sea: Gull Point at 4 km, Saltlight at 9 km, Kestrel Head at 15 km, and on. The next one is always on screen with the distance to go. Fly past one for a sweep of its beam, a distant bell and a lead over the storm, and it lights up on your Route. How far out can you get?

DAILY FLIGHT
Same waves for everyone, every day, and one try that counts. Then practise as much as you like. Keep your streak going and share your result.

GOALS, BIRDS AND SKIES
Three goals at a time take you up 15 levels. Eight birds, from Gull and Puffin to Albatross and Golden Gannet, five skies, from Golden Hour to Northern Lights and Moonrise, and coloured trails, unlocked as you level up. Every bird flies exactly the same; only the look changes.

SOUND AND FEEL
The wind, the hiss of the water, the chimes that climb with every perfect landing and the splash are all synthesised live in the app as you fly, and the haptics rise with your speed. Sound plays with the silent switch on; a setting makes Swoop respect it instead. Sound switches off, and haptics can be Off, Normal or Strong. Swoop follows Reduce Motion: no camera shake or screen bloom. Rather tap than hold? One tap folds the wings, the next opens them.

GAME CENTER
Top scores for your longest flight and the Daily Flight, and 12 achievements. It's optional: Swoop works fully without signing in.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no tracking, no data collected. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

review.notes:
Thanks for reviewing Swoop: a paid game with no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no data collection and no network requests of its own.

1. TESTING WITHOUT AN iPHONE DUO (start here)
You don't need a Duo. Everything works on any iPhone, on iPad (as an iPhone app) and in the Simulator, in landscape.
- Quickest look (under a minute): Fly > Skip (bottom corner) > a real flight.
- The first flight starts with Flight School, a short lesson on a calm practice sea (no storm, no score): a guide gull shows each move, then waits for you to copy it. Skip is there from the first step; Settings > Flight School replays it.
- Control: press and hold anywhere on the way down a wave (the wings fold, the bird dives faster), let go on the way up (it flies off the top). Land on the way down of the next wave for a "Perfect". One hold per wave; no flapping.
- A storm follows and speeds up; perfect landings push it back. The goal is the next lighthouse on a fixed route (Gull Point 4 km, Saltlight 9 km...), always shown at the top. When the storm catches up, "The storm caught you" appears and a card shows how far you got.
- Settings > "Wings by: Tapping": one tap folds, the next opens.

2. HOW THE HINGE IS USED (iPhone Duo)
Swoop reads the hinge angle only through the public iOS 27.1 API (SwiftUI onHingeChange), behind an availability check. No private API. The angle steers the bird while the game is on screen; it is never sent anywhere (only the usual resting angle is saved, on the device).
a) Hold the Duo open like a book (landscape, fold top to bottom), one hand on each half, relaxed. The resting angle calibrates itself.
b) Fold the halves in a little (about 30 degrees) on the way down a wave; open back on the way up.
c) Bird side: iOS briefly softens one half of the inner screen when a fold starts from flat, so on a Duo the bird flies on the half that stays sharp: by default the right half, flying right to left. Flight School asks once which half stayed clear (one tap, or "Not sure"). Settings > Bird side: Sharp side (auto), Left or Right.
d) Settings > "Play with touch" gives the press-and-hold control on a Duo.
e) Folded below about 55 degrees (well past an L shape) a flight pauses ("Open your wings to keep flying") and carries on when reopened. Closed: the outer display shows "Open your wings". Portrait: a card asks to turn the Duo sideways, with "Play with touch".

3. KIND TO THE DEVICE (Guidelines 2.4.2 and 1.4.5)
- Folds are short (about 30 degrees) and unhurried, about one per wave, in the middle of the hinge's range. The game eases the fold, so speed is never rewarded.
- Swoop never asks the user to close the phone, lay it flat, fold quickly or slam it. Opening flat gains nothing, and a one-time tip says so.
- No score, achievement or bonus rewards folding speed or fold count.
- During play the game reads the angle, never the closed state. Nothing is placed on the screens.

4. MODES AND UNLOCKS (nothing hidden, nothing to buy)
- Flight: endless, new waves every time. Lighthouses passed light up on the Route page.
- Daily Flight: the same waves for everyone that day, one try that counts, then practice. Shareable as text via the share sheet.
- Goals: three at a time, 15 levels. Levels unlock cosmetic birds, skies and trails (8 birds and 5 skies in all). Every bird flies the same.

5. CONTENT
A bird over ocean waves. The storm is weather (cloud, rain, a soft rumble); nothing is harmed.

6. PRIVACY
No third-party SDKs, analytics, ads, accounts or tracking. Progress and settings stay on the device. App Privacy: Data Not Collected.

7. GAME CENTER
Optional ("Scores" button on Home). 2 leaderboards (Longest Flight, Daily Flight), 12 achievements (625 points), none hidden.

8. OTHER
- No notifications. Debug and demo modes are disabled in Release builds.
- Sound plays with the silent switch on (playback audio, mixing); Settings > "Respect silent switch" turns that off. All sound is synthesized in the app.

nomination.name: Swoop - App Launch - iPhone Duo fold-to-dive flyer
nomination.description:
Swoop turns iPhone Duo into a pair of wings. Hold the Duo open like a book, one hand on each half: fold it a little and the bird dives down the face of an ocean wave; open it at the bottom and the bird flies off the top. The two halves of the phone fold with the bird.

The hinge is an analogue control, not a switch: how far you fold sets how heavy the bird is, so the skill is rhythm, one fold per wave. Land on the way down of the next wave for a Perfect; three in a row is a golden Tailwind. A storm chases you out to sea, and the goal is always the next lighthouse on a fixed route of named headlands.

A short Flight School teaches by showing: a guide gull does each move, then you copy it. The bird flies on the half of the screen that stays sharp when a fold starts from flat. A Daily Flight with the same waves for everyone, 15 levels of goals that unlock birds and skies, Game Center. Other iPhones play by pressing and holding. No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected.
nomination.notes: Optimized for iPhone Duo: built for book pose on the inner display. The bird stays on the half that doesn't blur when a fold starts from flat (Settings: Bird side). Uses the public iOS 27.1 hinge API with easy folds of about 30 degrees from a self-calibrating book pose; it never asks players to close the phone, lay it flat or fold fast. Taught by an interactive tutorial. Every sound is synthesized in the app. Also from us: Squish, and Brim (launching 17 Nov).
